about: Live sample of the question bank (tests/question-bank.json): 2 questions per category, mostly ones that were missing or partly covered before coverage round B3 (Entry 22), plus #1, #7 and #19, and 2 with no approved page (must fall back with a Who can help office). An answer passes if it cites a source whose title matches one of the expected pages. ids are the bank ids. Run: TESTS_FILE=tests/bank-live-sample.json RESULTS_FILE=docs/test-results-bank-sample.md npm run test:questions
